Finite time, limit and physical capacity are distinguished; cooling is explicitly classified as approach from above, not falsely called increasing growth. Both gaps and monotonicity are correct; no new DGL-solving requirement.
All three model mechanisms and initial values checked. Fresh case changes to partial empirical data and resource assumptions; it explicitly avoids claiming unique identification from three values.

Canonical modelling is actually assessed: fit a and k to capacity/observations; derivative maximum and inflection checked. Fresh initial condition above half capacity gives inflection before observation, not another S-curve.

First case genuinely combines substitution with further antiderivative work; second changes to logarithm-square structure and repeated parts. Equivalent methods allowed, both integrals and checking arguments verified.
